title: PPV, NPV, and screening arithmetic
dek: PPV = P(D+|T+). It moves with prevalence. A superb test in a rare-disease screen still yields mostly false positives.
story: PPV = Se π / (Se π + (1−Sp)(1−π)). NPV = Sp (1−π) / ((1−Se)π + Sp(1−π)). Same Bayes as the Beta–Binomial plate, now with a binary test. If you remember one formula from screening, remember that PPV is not Se.

Community TB screening: π might be 1%. Even Sp = 0.99 and Se = 0.90 give PPV ≈ 0.48. Half of positives are false in that arithmetic. Clinic triage with π = 20% using the same test has PPV ≈ 0.96. Prevalence changed the number you should quote, not the cartridge.
Predictive values estimated in a case-control diagnostic study (50% diseased by design) are not the PPV in the field. Either recompute with a local π or sample the target population.
deep: Odds form: posterior odds = LR+ × prior odds for a positive test. Prior odds = π/(1−π). This is the clean computation and the one that generalises to more than one test if you are careful about dependence.

Two tests are not independent given D just because you multiplied LRs. Xpert and smear both depend on bacillary load. The joint likelihood is a 4-cell multinomial given D, not LR_xpert × LR_smear unless you defend conditional independence.
Decision: choose operating point (trace vs positive, who to X-ray) by costs of FN vs FP, not by maximising Youden’s J in a vacuum. That is a loss function, not a p-value.
Uncertainty: δ-method or a Beta posterior on Se, Sp, π. With 8 culture-positives, Se is a wide posterior; PPV inherits that width.

formulas.label: PPV
formulas.note: Bayes. Plug field π, not the case-control mix.

visual.caption: Same Se=0.90, Sp=0.99, three prevalences. PPV collapses as π falls. The test did not get worse; the prior odds did. This is why community TB screening is an arithmetic problem as much as a cartridge problem.

example.title: Community screen, π = 0.01

steps.title: Expected cells
steps.body: 100 diseased, 90 true positives. 9,900 non-diseased, 99 false positives. PPV = 90/(90+99) ≈ 0.48.

steps.title: NPV
steps.body: 10 false negatives, 9,801 true negatives. NPV = 9801/(9801+10) ≈ 0.999. Reassuring negatives, unimpressive positives.

steps.title: Policy
steps.body: A confirmatory algorithm for T+ is not optional at this π. Quoting Se=90% to the community as if it were PPV is the error this plate exists to prevent.

example.takeaway: Compute expected TP and FP from π, Se, Sp. PPV is their ratio, not the cartridge brochure.
